generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Performance security within 20 days of receipt of the letter of acceptance. The successful tenderer shall deliver to the employer a security deposit in any forms for an amount equivalent to 5% of contractor price plus additional security for unbalanced tender in accordance with clause 25.5 of ITT & clause 44 of the conditions of contract for the works reserved for other category.

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)

List of works for which tenders already submitted

To qualify for award of this contract, each bidder in his/their name should have in the last 5 years, i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 Satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor for at least one similar type of work to an extent of 50% of amount put to tender for the work in any one of the above FY in any Government / Public undertaking sectors. Certificates should be issued from the cadre not less than the rank of the Executive Engineer with office outward number and date.
The bidder shall be Registered KPWD Civil contractor of Class IV and above.

Achieved in at least Two financial years Out of previous five financial years, minimum financial turnover of rupees not less than the value of work for work (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only). Turnover certificate duly certified by the Chartered Accountant with UDIN number along with P&L statement should be uploaded.
